en.title: Meet the new cast
en.intro: Familiar figures first. One identity across countries and growth forms. Compare every role with its legacy reference.
en.phase: Cast proposal preview · Gameplay translation and new art are still pending.
en.searchPlaceholder: New name, Chinese reference or source work
en.empty: No matching characters. Try another name or country.
en.recognitionNote: Familiarity labels are editorial estimates, not audience-survey rankings.
en.scope: The frozen source has {definitions} definitions and {names} display names. These include growth forms, common enemies, objects and interface labels. The recruitment catalog records {recruitmentForms} forms for {recruitmentIdentities} identities; this does not mean every cast role is recruitable.
en.identityNote: Fixed means the proposed identity is stable. It does not mean its dialogue, gameplay or artwork has already been adapted.
en.countryNote: Flags indicate this game's story affiliation, not a claim about a historical person's citizenship. Story connections do not create duplicate characters.
en.policy: Choose existing literary, legendary or historical figures before inventing a named character. Common guards and animals are classified separately.
en.sourceOnly: This read-only review tool never opens or modifies game saves.
en.noEvidence: No country-specific story references in this extraction.
en.error: The cast could not be loaded. Please refresh or try again later.

zh-CN.eyebrow: 十三个国家 · 一份统一角色表
zh-CN.title: 认识新的伙伴与对手
zh-CN.intro: 优先选择熟悉人物。同一角色跨国、成长后仍保持一个身份，每项都可查看原角色对应。
zh-CN.phase: 角色方案预览｜剧情翻译与新美术尚未接入。
zh-CN.searchPlaceholder: 新名字、原角色或来源作品
zh-CN.empty: 没有找到匹配角色，请换个名字或国家。
zh-CN.recognitionNote: 熟悉度是选材判断，不是观众调查排名。
zh-CN.scope: 冻结源包有 {definitions} 个定义、{names} 个显示名，包含成长形态、普通敌兵、物件和界面标签。招募图鉴记录 {recruitmentForms} 个形态、对应 {recruitmentIdentities} 个身份，不代表全部剧情人物都可以招募。
zh-CN.identityNote: 身份固定表示采用稳定的角色对应，不表示对白、玩法或美术已经完成改编。
zh-CN.countryNote: 国旗表示本游戏的故事主归属，不等同于历史人物的真实国籍。跨国关联不会生成另一个同名角色。
zh-CN.policy: 先找合适的知名文学、传说或历史人物，确实缺少才原创。普通卫兵、动物等单独分类。
zh-CN.sourceOnly: 这是只读审阅工具，不会打开或修改游戏存档。
zh-CN.noEvidence: 本次抽取未发现国家线专属关联。
zh-CN.presentation-and-relationship-review: 形象及人物关系需要改编校对
zh-CN.regional-familiarity-review: 本土人物，需要检查观众辨识度
zh-CN.legacy-form-label-review: 原成长形态标签需要校对
zh-CN.story-role-review: 需要审阅剧情与战斗定位是否合适
